* The United States defense budget is set to exceed US$400 billion next year&mdash;an almost 7% increase&mdash;according to budget proposals inadvertently posted on [[the Pentagon]]'s website.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/americas/3447281.stm|title=BBC NEWS - Americas - US defence bill to exceed $400bn|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://breakingnews.iol.ie/news/story.asp?j=93200472&p=93zxyy78|title=BreakingNews.ie - Irish News - Breaking News from Ireland|accessdate=22 December 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060514070746/http://breakingnews.iol.ie/news/story.asp?j=93200472&p=93zxyy78|archive-date=14 May 2006|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* The People's Republic of China puts [[poultry]] export bans on three more areas after a [[World Health Organization]] warning that the chance of controlling the [[avian influenza|Avian flu]] outbreak is slipping.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/asia-pacific/3446881.stm|title=BBC NEWS - Asia-Pacific - Bird flu pressure mounts on China|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref> A new [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome|SARS]] case is confirmed in [[Guangdong]] province.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.reuters.co.uk/newsArticle.jhtml?type=healthNews&storyID=4254330&section=news |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050413202638/http://www.reuters.co.uk/newsArticle.jhtml?type=healthNews&storyID=4254330&section=news |archive-date=2005-04-13 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* [[British Airways]] and [[Air France]] cancel five upcoming US flights to [[Washington, D.C.]] and [[Miami, Florida]] amid fears of targeting by [[Al-Qaida]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/uk/3447715.stm|title=BBC NEWS - UK - 'Al-Qaeda threat' grounds flights|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/articles/A839-2004Jan31.html |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-12-20 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121026052229/http://www.washingtonpost.com/wp-dyn/articles/A839-2004Jan31.html |archive-date=2012-10-26 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.forbes.com/personalfinance/retirement/newswire/2004/01/31/rtr1237099.html |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-12-20 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041208184327/http://www.forbes.com/personalfinance/retirement/newswire/2004/01/31/rtr1237099.html |archive-date=2004-12-08 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* The [[Svalbard]] Undersea Cable System is officially put into operation, giving the island group at 78° North a 40[[gigabit|Gb]] connection to the Norwegian mainland. The dual 1,440&nbsp;km [[fiber optic]] lines from Svalbard to [[Harstad Municipality|Harstad]] is needed for communicating with [[polar orbit]]ing satellite stations on Svalbard, some owned by [[NASA]] and [[NOAA]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ksat.no/|title=KONGSBERG SATELLITE SERVICES |author=sdmin|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.tyco.com/tyco/press_release_detail.asp?prid=622 |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050825155039/http://www.tyco.com/tyco/press_release_detail.asp?prid=622 |archive-date=2005-08-25 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* [[Copper]] prices rise to a 6-year high in New York as 441 [[labor union|union]]ised workers [[strike action|strike]] at [[BHP Billiton]]'s Cerro Colorado mine in northern [[Chile]] after pay negotiations fail.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.globeandmail.com/servlet/ArticleNews/TPStory/LAC/20040131/RCOMX31/TPBusiness/MoneyMarkets |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040411213156/http://www.globeandmail.com/servlet/ArticleNews/TPStory/LAC/20040131/RCOMX31/TPBusiness/MoneyMarkets |archive-date=2004-04-11 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
